local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local DialogModule = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("DialogModule"))

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local npc = script.Parent
local prompt = npc:WaitForChild("ProximityPrompt")
local actionRemote = npc:WaitForChild("OldCowboyQuestActionC2S")

local dialogObject = DialogModule.new("Old Cowboy", npc, prompt)
local busy = false
local session = 0

dialogObject:addDialog(
	"You got them all... Thank you. I knew the stories about bounty hunters had some truth to them.",
	{"Who were they?"}
)
dialogObject:addDialog(
	"Trouble from my past. I never meant for it to reach you, but I could use your help.",
	{"What can I do?"}
)
dialogObject:addDialog(
	"I have one last escort job. Get me safely to an old cemetery—no questions asked. Five gems for your trouble.",
	{"You've got a deal.", "I'm not taking that job."}
)
dialogObject:addDialog(
	"I understand. Thank you for hearing me out. The offer stands if you change your mind.",
	{"Maybe another time."}
)
dialogObject:addDialog(
	"This is the place. You kept me safe, and I won't forget it.",
	{"And the five gems?"}
)
dialogObject:addDialog(
	"Your payment is set aside. Come back tomorrow, and all five gems will be yours.",
	{"Why not now?"}
)
dialogObject:addDialog(
	"Because tonight I need a little time alone. Please come back tomorrow—I'll tell you what I can.",
	{"All right."}
)

local function showDialog(index)
	dialogObject:triggerDialog(player, index)
end

local function closeDialog()
	dialogObject:hideGui("")
	busy = false
end

prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(triggeringPlayer)
	if triggeringPlayer and triggeringPlayer ~= player then
		return
	end
	if busy then
		return
	end
	local state = npc:GetAttribute("OldCowboyQuestState")

local UIHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("UIHelper"))

local folder = script.Parent
local Store = folder.Store
local originScale = Store:GetScale()
local Hightlight = folder.Highlight

math.randomseed(tick())
function popReadyTips()
	local characters:{Model} = game.CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.OnWildBoarBattleGround)
	for _,character in ipairs(characters) do
		local player = game.Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
		UIHelper.onPopCenterTips:FireClient(player,"🪨The rockfall is ready!")
	end
end

function onTrigger()
	local downStore = Store:Clone()
	downStore:ScaleTo(originScale)
	downStore.PrimaryPart.Anchored = false
	downStore.TouchPart.Touched:Connect(function(otherPart: BasePart) 
		if not downStore.TouchPart.CanTouch then return end
		if otherPart:IsDescendantOf(downStore) or otherPart:IsDescendantOf(Store) then return end
		if not otherPart.CanCollide then return end
		downStore.TouchPart.CanTouch = false
		downStore.PrimaryPart.Anchored = true
		
		--print("碰到了",otherPart.Name)
		
		for _,child in ipairs(downStore:GetDescendants()) do
			if child:IsA("WeldConstraint") then
				child:Destroy()
			end
		end
		
		for _,child in ipairs(downStore:GetDescendants()) do
			if child == downStore.PrimaryPart then continue end
			if child == downStore.TouchPart then continue end

			if child:IsA("BasePart") then
				child.Anchored = false
				child:SetNetworkOwner(nil)
				child.CanCollide = true
				child.CollisionGroup = GameEnum.CollisionGroup.OnlyDefault
				local r = math.random(40,60)
				local a = 10
				child.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(math.random(-r,r),r,math.random(-r,r))
				child.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(math.random(-a,a),math.random(-a,a),math.random(-a,a))
			end
		end
		
		local king:Model = CommonFunc:FindFirstAncestorByTag(otherPart,GameEnum.Tag.WildBoarKing)
		if king then
			local characters = game.CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.OnWildBoarBattleGround)
			if #characters then
				-- 受伤
				local player = game.Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(table.remove(characters,1,#characters))
				GameHelper:NPCTakeDamage(player,king,500)	
				-- 给个hight light
				Hightlight.Adornee = king
				task.delay(0.5,function()
					Hightlight.Adornee = nil
				end)
				
				-- 播放命中音效
				local sound = script.Hit:Clone()
				sound.Parent = king.PrimaryPart
				sound:Play()
				game.Debris:AddItem(sound,3)
				
			end
		end
		downStore.RootPart.broken:Play()
		game.Debris:AddItem(downStore.TouchPart,3)
		--downStore.TouchPart:Destroy()
	end)
	downStore.Parent = workspace
	game.Debris:AddItem(downStore,10)
end

CommonFunc:GetInstanceTagAddedSignal(GameEnum.Tag.WildBoarKing,function(king: Model, connections: {RBXScriptConnection}) 
	local LocalOrder:BindableEvent = king:WaitForChild("LocalOrder")
	table.insert(connections,LocalOrder.Event:Connect(function(cmd:string) 
		if cmd == "砸地" then
			if Store:GetScale() >= originScale then
				Store:ScaleTo(0.001)

				onTrigger()

				local t = 0
				while true do
					local dt = task.wait()
					t = math.clamp(t+dt,0.001,10)
					local alpha = t/10
					Store:ScaleTo(alpha * originScale)
					if alpha >= 1 then break end
				end
				popReadyTips()
			end
		end
	end)) 
end)"},{"id":254,"text":"if not game.ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("玩法开关"):FindFirstChild("疯猪祭坛").Value then

local _bossDiedTimes = 0

function clearTreasures()
	for _,oldTreasure in ipairs(_treasures) do
		oldTreasure:Destroy()
	end
	table.clear(_treasures)
end

function createTreasures()
	clearTreasures()
	
	for _,att:Attachment in ipairs(folder.TreasurePoints:GetChildren()) do
		table.insert(_treasures,GameHelper:CreateTreasureByName(att.Name,att.WorldCFrame))
	end
end

function spawnBoss()
	if boss then return end
	
	clearTreasures()
	
	boss = _bossPrefab:Clone()
	boss:PivotTo(folder:FindFirstChild("Boss出生点").WorldCFrame)
	local humanoidRootPart:Part = boss.HumanoidRootPart
	--CommonFunc:SetAllScriptEnabled(boss,true)
	
	local humanoid:Humanoid = boss.Humanoid
	humanoid.MaxHealth += _bossDiedTimes * 1000
	humanoid.Health = humanoid.MaxHealth
	humanoid.Died:Connect(function() 
		boss = nil
		_bossDiedTimes += 1

		-- 击杀所有的小野猪喽啰
		local minions = game.CollectionService:GetTagged("WildBoarsKingMinion")
		for _,animal:Model in ipairs(minions) do
			GameHelper:NPCTakeDamage(nil,animal,9999)
		end
		
		v_BossSpawn_CD.Value = 25*60 -- 25分钟后刷新
		
		-- 创建宝箱
		createTreasures()
	end)
	boss.Mad.Changed:Connect(function(value: boolean) 
		if value and humanoid.Health > 0 then
			-- 抓狂时候再刷新小猪
			spawnMinion()
		end	
	end)
	boss.Parent = workspace:FindFirstChild("沼泽")
end

-- 生成野猪
function spawnMinion()
	local parent = workspace:FindFirstChild("沼泽")
	for _,child in ipairs(folder:FindFirstChild("小野猪出生点"):GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("Attachment") then
			local animal:Model = EnemyHelper:CreateWildBoar(parent)
			animal:PivotTo(child.WorldCFrame)
			animal.Humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
				animal:RemoveTag("WildBoarsKingMinion")
			end)
			animal:AddTag("WildBoarsKingMinion")
		end
	end
end

	overlapParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
	
	local hits = workspace:GetPartsInPart(folder.ZonePart,overlapParams)
	for _,hit in ipairs(hits) do
		local character:Model = CommonFunc:FindFirstAncestorByTag(hit,GameEnum.Tag.Player)
		local index = table.find(characters,character)
		if index then
			table.remove(characters,index)
			if not character:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.OnWildBoarBattleGround) then
				print(character.Name, "进入野猪王洞穴")
